skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Rose Rider
skins.content: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Rose Rider. Outfit Verdant wears when passing along the love of others. A casual and leisurely ensemble. The red jacket and the design on the jeans go well with the festive roses.
skins.quote: The fowlbeasts were flocking around the 'Scarecrow', so Verdant decided to rest a little in the plaza, taking in the bright sunshine and petals wafting in the wind. Not a bad combo, he thought.
